instrumentation: Private synchronous Node module load hook wraps published picomatch entry and callable properties; no installed file changes. Positive entry/makeRe controls. Observational record of these build/test invocations, not exhaustive coverage of arbitrary configs/devservers.
allObservedPatternOrigins: Vite/Vitest defaults, repository test include literal, and tinyglobby subdivisions of that literal. No observed browser/API/terminal user content becomes a compile pattern.
scope: Trusted build/test inputs and inspected native runtime boundary support a not-present runtime disposition. Generic4.0.7 behavior is not repaired; arbitrary patterns, modified plugins/configs and development servers remain out of this evidence scope. No release waiver or issue closure.

staticInputReview.finding: The production-build call compiles resolved server.fs.deny configuration; observed values equal locked Vite defaults. Browser requests are match subjects, not patterns for this call.
Project file discovery forwards configured include/exclude literals to tinyglobby. The committed include is fixed; default excludes are locked dependency code.
Compile processed pattern/ignore lists once, then pass crawled paths to returned match functions. Paths from directory contents do not become compile patterns on this path.

classificationReview.nativeRuntime: Not present in all twelve inspected archives and byte-matched embedded UI; two MSI files keep checksum/install-smoke scope only.
classificationReview.currentBuildTest: No untrusted pattern-definition API in the reviewed default production build/test paths. Config/source/plugin authors have the existing authority to execute JavaScript during builds; arbitrary edited configurations and development-server deployments require their own review.
classificationReview.genericMatcher: Three of six retained repeated-extglob probes still timeout; no algorithm repair or arbitrary-pattern safety claim.
classificationReview.advisoryReconciliation: Pinned upstream maintainer recommends trusted patterns; GitHub withdrawal and unchanged gate reflect reclassification. CVE PUBLISHED is retained, not mislabeled rejected.
classificationReview.releaseGate: Exactc195 unchanged audit job succeeded; full original CI and native cohort still live. No waiver, override, downgrade, version substitution or threshold change.
classificationReview.recommendedDisposition: Resolve repository exposure by runtime non-presence plus trusted build-input boundary after current exact-head required checks and review; do not claim generic4.0.7 repaired.
